title: G-operator Definition
description: Essential Criteria: The definition of the G-operator must be correctly stated as G = C e^(i pi I_2).

title: G-parity Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The explanation of why G-parity was introduced in particle physics should be clear and include its relation to isospin and charge conjugation.

title: Eigenvalues for Pions
description: Essential Criteria: The eigenvalue of G for pions must be correctly identified as G = -1 for pi mesons and G(n pi) = (-1)^n for n pions.

title: G-values for Mesons
description: Essential Criteria: The G-parity values for rho, omega, phi, and eta mesons must be accurately provided.

title: Decay Relation
description: Important Criteria: The relationship between G-parity and decay processes for rho, omega, and phi mesons should be correctly explained.

title: C-value for eta
description: Important Criteria: The charge conjugation value for eta meson must be correctly stated as C(eta^0) = +1.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any incorrect sign or factor in the G-parity calculations or definitions will result in a deduction.

title: Units and Notation
description: Optional Criteria: Proper use of units and notation throughout the response should be maintained.
